show.description: "Divorced and Desired" is a fiery tale of betrayal, ambition, and reinvention. When Ishita is dumped for power and prestige, she doesn’t just bounce back—she builds an empire and makes her ex beg for mercy. This drama-packed audio series is your front-row seat to revenge, romance, and ruthless success. Watch Now!
